rule.name: Overly Permissive Cordova Whitelist
rule.rule_desc: A browser-origin or navigation policy permits a broad set of external origins or destinations. Identify the resources and privileged interfaces covered by the effective policy.
rule.vuln_desc: An untrusted site may read protected responses or invoke privileged interfaces if a permissive policy admits it and independent authentication or authorization does not prevent the operation.
rule.developer: Allow only required trusted origins and destinations. Validate origin and message schemas, handle credentials deliberately, and enforce access controls independently of the origin policy.
rule.reviewer: Verify whitelist rules are limited to approved domains and protocols. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Insecure External URL Handling
rule.rule_desc: The code handles a link, redirect, or externally selected navigation target. Validate the effective destination and any action triggered by the receiving handler.
rule.vuln_desc: A crafted destination or link may direct users to a phishing site, leak URL-carried secrets, or trigger unauthorized operations if routing trusts external parameters without the required access checks.
rule.developer: Allowlist schemes, hosts, paths, and operations. Validate parsed link parameters, avoid credentials in URLs, and require authentication and authorization before sensitive actions.
rule.reviewer: Check URL construction and ensure strict allowlist validation exists. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Sensitive Data Stored in Web Storage
rule.rule_desc: The application stores sensitive values or configures protection for persistent data. Determine the actual storage location, backup policy, and lock-state access restrictions.
rule.vuln_desc: An actor with access to unprotected application files, backups, or overly broad keychain access may recover credentials or private records and use them outside the intended trust boundary.
rule.developer: Use the platform credential or key store for secrets and appropriate authenticated encryption and file protection for private records. Minimize stored data, backup exposure, and lock-state accessibility.
rule.reviewer: Verify sensitive data classes are excluded from web storage usage. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Cordova Wildcard Access Origin
rule.rule_desc: The application network allowlist permits requests to any origin.
rule.vuln_desc: A compromised web context may send application data to an attacker-controlled endpoint if unrestricted outbound requests and access to sensitive data are both available.
rule.developer: Limit outbound origins to required trusted services. Keep sensitive values out of untrusted web contexts and apply a restrictive content-security policy and independent native access checks.
rule.reviewer: Review config.xml access policy entries. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Cordova Unsafe CSP Directives
rule.rule_desc: Browser or embedded-renderer configuration relaxes an isolation or content-execution control. Determine which external content can reach the affected context.
rule.vuln_desc: Untrusted page content may cross an intended browser or renderer boundary, execute privileged operations, or access protected data when the relaxed control exposes those capabilities.
rule.developer: Restore origin and process isolation, keep privileged APIs out of untrusted renderers, and use a restrictive content-security policy without unnecessary unsafe execution directives.
rule.reviewer: Audit CSP config in HTML/meta headers and templates. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Cordova Insecure HTTP Endpoint Usage
rule.rule_desc: The checked source contains a transport-security exception, insecure endpoint, or certificate-validation configuration. Resolve the effective policy and the connections it governs.
rule.vuln_desc: An attacker on the network may read or alter affected traffic if sensitive data travels over cleartext or the connection accepts an untrusted server. Normal HTTPS endpoints and correctly implemented validation do not establish exposure.
rule.developer: Use HTTPS with normal certificate-chain and hostname verification. Remove permissive production callbacks and broad transport exceptions; restrict any justified exception to a documented, non-sensitive endpoint.
rule.reviewer: Audit endpoint constants and plugin config values. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Cordova WebView JavaScript Bridge Marker
rule.rule_desc: The application renders web content, executes scripts, or exposes a native messaging interface. Resolve navigation trust, origin isolation, and validation at the native boundary.
rule.vuln_desc: Attacker-controlled web content may execute in a trusted context or invoke native operations, exposing session data or application privileges when isolation and per-operation checks are insufficient.
rule.developer: Restrict navigation and message origins to required trusted sources. Avoid dynamic script construction, minimize native bridge methods, validate message inputs, and authorize sensitive native operations.
rule.reviewer: Review plugin bridge interfaces and content trust assumptions. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.

rule.name: Cordova Hardcoded Secret Marker
rule.rule_desc: The checked source or build configuration embeds potentially sensitive credential or key material. Determine whether it is active and whether it reaches distributed artifacts or logs.
rule.vuln_desc: A party who can read exposed source, artifacts, configuration, or logs may recover active secrets and access the protected service or decrypt data with the secret owner’s privileges.
rule.developer: Remove active secrets from source and build layers, rotate exposed values, and load replacements through a restricted secret-management facility. Use narrowly privileged, short-lived credentials.
rule.reviewer: Validate no static production secrets are shipped. This can be confirmed as an issue when the matched path is reachable and required controls are missing, weak, or inconsistent.
